speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for seeing me. You mentioned intense itching and red bumps on your thigh and other areas; can you tell me how long these symptoms have been present and if the bumps are itchy, painful, or filled with fluid?

speaker: Patient
text: 47-year-old male. The patient presents with intense itching of his right thigh region for the past few days. He also mentions the recent formation of ‘red bumps’ in the same area. The patient has recently attended a business conference in Miami. He has a past medical history of hypertension, diabetes type 2, and hyperlipidemia. The patient’s medication regimen includes enalapril, metformin, and atorvastatin. He denies any history of smoking or drinking.

speaker: Doctor
text: The history of recent travel to Miami with intense itching and new red bumps on the thighs raises concern for Strongyloides stercoralis infection or a drug eruption from your atorvastatin or enalapril. Did you notice if the bumps appeared shortly after returning from your trip, and have you experienced any respiratory symptoms like coughing or shortness of breath? REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count, Eosinophil_Count
